title: Launchpath hero infographic and modular step-card system for Quickstart landing
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Design and deliver a refreshed hero infographic and a modular step-card component system for the Quickstart landing page (Launchpath). Deliverables include high-fidelity Figma frames for desktop/tablet/mobile, production-ready PNG/SVG exports of hero and icons, a screenshot pipeline for up-to-date product imagery, and a dev handoff with tokens and redlines. Goal: improve first-run clarity, reduce time-to-first-success, and increase CTA click-throughs while keeping assets compatible with console and docs styling.
acceptance_criteria: Figma master file with separate pages: Hero-Infographic, Step-Cards, Tokens & Redlines
Desktop hero at 1440px with alternate 1200px layout; tablet and mobile variants with stacked content
Modular step-card component with states: default, hover, completed, disabled, and loading
Accessible color token mapping (AA contrast for body text, 4.5:1 for primary CTAs)
Exported artboards: hero@1x/2x PNGs, hero SVG for animation team, step-card PNGs and SVG icons
Design-to-dev handoff in Figma with CSS token spec and a short implementation guide (tokens, spacing scale, z-index notes)
Screenshot pipeline documented with scripts/PR template for updating product screenshots in future releases
Stakeholder sign-off from PM (Priya Shah) and Eng lead (Marco Nguyen)
QA checklist passed: visual diff < 0.5% on main screens, responsiveness tested on target breakpoints
design_notes: Hero concept: "Launchpath" metaphor — a horizontal timeline band with three progressive nodes mapping to onboarding milestones
Use subtle depth via layered gradients and a soft drop shadow to read well on varied backgrounds without heavy skeuomorphism
Prefer simplified schematic screenshots inside mask frames rather than full-screen captures to focus attention on key controls
Step-card system should be built from existing design tokens (spacing-4/8/16, radius-8) and use new accent token --accent-amber for contrast against console blues
Microcopy collaboration: worked with UX writer to shorten step titles and keep CTAs under 3 words for card buttons
Animations: provide Lottie-ready hero SVG with separated layers (background band, node glow, line draw) for frontend to animate on scroll
